title: Plagues of Locusts and Darkness

questions.question: What did the eighth plague bring upon Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:14-15 (ESV): "The locusts came up over all the land of Egypt... they covered the face of the whole land."

questions.question: What was the ninth plague?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:21-22 (ESV): "There was pitch darkness in all the land of Egypt three days."

questions.question: How long did the darkness last in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:22 (ESV): "There was pitch darkness in all the land of Egypt three days."

questions.question: What did the locusts eat?
options: Only the crops in the palace
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:15 (ESV): "They ate all the plants in the land and all the fruit of the trees that the hail had left."

questions.question: Could the Israelites see during the darkness?
options: No, they were also in darkness
Yes, they had light where they lived
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, they had light where they lived
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:23 (ESV): "But all the people of Israel had light where they lived."

questions.question: What did God say He hardened Pharaoh's heart for?
options: To show His signs and that Israel may know He is the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To show His signs and that Israel may know He is the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:1-2 (ESV): "That I may show these signs of mine among them, and that you may know that I am the Lord."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh offer after the locusts - who could go?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:11 (ESV): "Go, the men among you, and serve the Lord."

questions.question: What did Moses demand that made Pharaoh refuse after darkness?
options: Their livestock must go too - not a hoof left behind
questions.correctAnswer: Their livestock must go too - not a hoof left behind
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:26 (ESV): "Our livestock also must go with us; not a hoof shall be left behind."

questions.question: What brought the locusts into Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:13 (ESV): "The Lord brought an east wind upon the land all that day and all that night... the east wind had brought the locusts."

questions.question: What carried the locusts away?
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:19 (ESV): "The Lord turned the wind into a very strong west wind, which lifted the locusts and drove them into the Red Sea."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh's servants say about Moses before the locusts?
options: "Egypt is ruined - let the people go"
questions.correctAnswer: "Egypt is ruined - let the people go"
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:7 (ESV): "Pharaoh's servants said, 'Let the men go... Do you not yet understand that Egypt is ruined?'"

questions.question: What did Pharaoh threaten Moses with after the darkness?
options: Death if he saw his face again
questions.correctAnswer: Death if he saw his face again
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:28 (ESV): "Pharaoh said to him, 'Never see my face again, for on the day you see my face you shall die.'"

questions.question: How did Moses respond to Pharaoh's death threat?
options: "As you say! I will not see your face again"
questions.correctAnswer: "As you say! I will not see your face again"
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:29 (ESV): "Moses said, 'As you say! I will not see your face again.'"

questions.question: According to Exodus 10:2, why should Israel tell future generations about the plagues?
options: So they may know that I am the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: So they may know that I am the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:2 (ESV): "That you may tell... what signs I have done among them, that you may know that I am the Lord."

questions.question: What type of darkness was the ninth plague described as?
options: A darkness that could be felt
questions.correctAnswer: A darkness that could be felt
questions.explanation: Exodus 10:21 (ESV): "Stretch out your hand... that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, a darkness to be felt."

key_verse_text: That you may tell in the hearing of your son and of your grandson how I have dealt harshly with the Egyptians and what signs I have done among them, that you may know that I am the Lord.
